verdict.rationale: Algolia ships an agent-building product (Agent Studio, which connects an LLM to Algolia search and tools), so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question here. However, nothing in the evidence shows Agent Studio or any other part of Algolia acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers. The MCP evidence covers only Algolia's own MCP server, which exposes Algolia to other agents and is the opposite role.
